title: Personal Liability Limit Endorsement: CondoGuard Service Desk Reference
content:
A named insured of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy may ask to raise the policy's personal liability limit midterm. The raise is made by a liability endorsement recorded by the service representative.

## Effective date

A liability raise takes effect on the day the named insured requests it, and that day is before the expiration date.

## What the endorsement records

One call records the liability endorsement, with the new limit, its full-year premium effect and the premium charged for the rest of the term, marked as additional premium. It sets the liability limit shown on the declarations to the new limit and posts the charge as an additional-premium entry on the policy's premium account, raising the amount owed by that charge. On success the declarations show the new liability limit and the premium account shows the new charge. The endorsement is effective on the day it is recorded.

## Invocation

The tool is `raise_liability_limit_70984c5d`, an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `condo_policy_id` | the reference number of the CondoGuard policy being endorsed, as returned by the condo policy lookup for the verified customer | reference number, text |
| `liability_limit` | the new personal liability limit the declarations will show | USD, 2 decimal places, stored exactly as passed |
| `annual_premium_change` | the full-year premium effect of the raise | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount, rounded half-up to the cent when stored |
| `prorated_premium` | the premium charged for the rest of the current term | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount, rounded half-up to the cent when stored and posted as the additional-premium charge |

## Return

On success the tool returns a receipt whose `status` is `liability_raised`, with `endorsement_id` (reference number of the new endorsement entry), `billing_id` (reference number of the additional-premium entry), `condo_policy_id` (the policy endorsed), `liability_limit` (the limit now on the declarations, USD), `effective_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `prorated_premium` (the charge posted, USD).

## Illustration (hypothetical values, not a quote)

A call with `liability_limit` 500000.00, `annual_premium_change` 14.00 and `prorated_premium` 7.67 returns `status` `liability_raised`, `liability_limit` 500000.0 and `prorated_premium` 7.67, dated today; the premium account then owes 7.67 USD more than before.
